userFeedback: Avoid clutter from listing basic and seasonal versions as separate characters.
structure: One main-list card per character; a selected-character outfit button opens a bottom sheet containing that character's outfits only.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one revised Sobrita UI concept showing TWO STATES OF THE SAME CHOSEN MOBILE WORKFLOW side by side, not alternative design directions.
Primary request: Make the character selector simpler: EACH BASE CHARACTER GETS ONLY ONE CARD. Costume variations appear ONLY in a small bottom sheet opened for the currently selected character. Show the collapsed character list at left and the same screen with Michi's costume sheet open at right. This is a direct revision of the supplied wardrobe mockup.

Target dimensions: Each mobile viewport represents 390 x 844 logical px. Put two equally sized complete rectangular app-content viewports side by side with a 48 px cream gutter and 34 px space for a short caption above each; total composition about 828 x 878 logical px. High-resolution proportional output. No physical phones, bezels, rounded device masks, notch, OS bars, clock, battery, home indicator, drop-shadowed phone mockups or browser chrome. No oversized editorial heading. Only two small captions ABOVE the app viewports: left "평소 캐릭터 목록", right "의상 바꾸기를 누르면". Show exactly these two states of one workflow.

Input images and exact roles:
Image 1: the existing chosen "꾸미기" mobile mockup, an EDIT TARGET for its room, layout proportions, illustrated pixel style and cream/navy/teal design system. IMPORTANT: its ALWAYS-OPEN TWO MICHI COSTUME TILES below the room are the part that must be REPLACED. Do not copy that permanent duplicate-cat layout into the revised main screen.
Image 2: actual Dracula Michi reference, the navy cat with folded ear and red cape. This is Michi's CURRENTLY WORN costume.
Image 3: original uncostumed Michi reference; this image appears ONLY as the "기본" option INSIDE the right-hand costume bottom sheet, NEVER as a second main-list character.
Image 4: a reference sheet for Miru, the apricot curly poodle. Extract only its large main seated poodle design for Miru's one character thumbnail; do not reproduce the sheet, title or other poses.
Image 5: actual Yoshi, the gray schnauzer with sky-blue eyes, cream brows and beard; use its seated design for Yoshi's one character thumbnail.
Preserve exact identities, palettes, asymmetrical Michi ears, poodle curls, schnauzer beard and eye colors. No invented characters or additional costumes.

Hard UX rules:
1. Main character list contains one card named "Michi", one named "Miru", one named "Yoshi". Exactly THREE VISIBLE CHARACTER CARDS, one per species. It must NOT contain separate "기본 Michi" and "드라큘라 Michi" cards. Do not create a costume tab or mix costumes with species cards.
2. Michi's ONE main character card shows his currently worn Dracula appearance, with name simply "Michi". The current character selection is Michi; Miru and Yoshi are unselected and wearing their normal appearance.
3. A quiet contextual "의상 바꾸기" button appears ONLY next to selected Michi's name above the character row. Other characters do NOT each have extra costume buttons or badges.
4. Costume choices are hidden in the left state and shown ONLY inside the right state's transient bottom sheet. The right sheet contains ONLY TWO COSTUMES FOR MICHI, labeled "기본" and "드라큘라". Miru and Yoshi must never appear as costume choices.
5. Costumes have already been received and are permanently kept. The event claiming lives elsewhere; NO gift-claim button, prices, ads, daily missions or timers on these screens.
6. Choosing an outfit only changes the appearance of the same Michi. It does not add another character, replace his proper name or unlock any other character.

Style: Match the supplied existing screen's warm paper #F6EFE0 and surface #FFFDF7, navy #202848, teal #0E7A72, pale teal #D8EDEA, gold #C0873A and goldSoft #F7E9CE. Pixelify-like Latin and matching legible Korean pixel font; body 14–16 logical px, section titles 20–23. Crisp square controls with 2–3 px navy outlines. Teal selection outline and small square checkmark. No generic pill-card redesign, no heavy shadows, no dark theme. The room art remains warm, detailed pixel art and the characters keep their reference rendering.

LEFT STATE, normal collapsed character list:
Top app bar: back arrow, title "꾸미기", small teal text action "완료".
Upper room preview retains the supplied illustrated living room: window and teal curtains, armchair, plant, lavender rug. Exactly ONE Dracula Michi sits naturally on the rug, full body visible at the same scale as in the edit target.
Below room: existing category strip "방 | 가구 | 벽·바닥 | 소품 | 캐릭터", with "캐릭터" selected in teal.
Below strip: contextual row with bold "Michi" at left and a small outline button with tiny clothing icon and exact text "의상 바꾸기" at right. A quiet small subtitle says "현재 의상: 드라큘라".
Below that: ONE horizontal row of THREE compact character tiles, equal widths, neatly spaced, about 125 logical px tall. First tile is the exact Dracula Michi with label "Michi", teal selected outline and small square checkmark. Second tile is regular apricot poodle with label "Miru". Third is regular gray blue-eyed schnauzer with label "Yoshi". Each character appears in the list ONCE. This is a pet selector, not a wardrobe.
Leave breathing room below. No extra large button, extra panels, seasonal banners, extra badges or expanded costume cards. A small quiet help line may read "함께할 친구를 골라요.".

RIGHT STATE, same main screen with a contextual bottom sheet open:
The underlying UI is IDENTICAL to the left screen, lightly dimmed, with the same room and three-card pet row behind the overlay. Do not substitute a different base layout. A cream square-corner bottom sheet covers approximately the bottom 37 to 41 percent of the viewport, with a crisp navy top rule.
Sheet header EXACTLY "Michi의 의상", small close "×" at right.
One quiet helper "기본 모습도 언제든 선택할 수 있어요.".
Two compact equal wardrobe tiles side by side: left the exact uncostumed Michi from ref 3 with label "기본"; right the exact Dracula Michi from ref 2 with label "드라큘라", tiny gold "영구 소장" label, teal selected border and small square checkmark. Size thumbnails about 75–85 logical px so the sheet stays compact; DO NOT make two huge card panels.
A full-width teal square primary button at sheet bottom reads EXACTLY "이 의상 입히기".
No other characters in the sheet. No event-expiration date. No duplicate selectable base-character cards outside the sheet.

Date anchor: 2026-10-23, America/Mexico_City. Avoid dates in the UI since received outfits are permanent.
Output ONE image showing the two states of this single revised workflow, clear correct Korean copy, no extra screens, annotations or arrows. Make the distinction visually unmistakable: left, three DIFFERENT characters once each; right, only two appearances of SELECTED Michi inside a temporary sheet.
